scroll-view.$description: ScrollView: content that scrolls in a box of its own, a pull-down panel above it and a loading panel under it.

panel-height.$description: The pull-down and the loading panels.

panel-gap.$description: Between a panel's indicator and its text.

box.$description: The box that scrolls: `focus` when the keys put focus on it.

pull.$description: The panel above the content, shown as it is pulled: `release` once far enough, `refreshing` while it refreshes.

bottom.$description: The panel under the content while more loads.
